label: uworld-exhibit-image-investigation
context: ## UWorld Exhibit Image Investigation — In Progress ### Goal UWorld Anki cards are missing exhibit images. Questions with clickable "Exhibit" links (blue hyperlinks that open a dialog with an image) were created without those images. Need to fix the pipeline to include exhibit images. ### Key Findings So Far 1. **Two types of images in UWorld questions:** - **Inline `` tags** — already embedded in questionText HTML with direct URLs like `https://www.uworld.com/media/L26367.jpg`. These were partially handled (275 cards have broken `` tags pointing to uworld.com that Anki can't load). - **Exhibit links** — `exhibit` in the raw API HTML, rendered as `exhibit` in the Angular app. Clicking opens a dialog with an `` loading from `https://apps.uworld.com/media/U5570.png` etc. 2. **Exhibit ID → Media URL mapping:** - Exhibit href IDs (e.g., 14504, 3808, 21266, 79162) are used in `exhibit` in the API response - SOME IDs map directly to media URLs: `L21266.jpg`, `L79162.png` (confirmed 200 OK) - OTHER IDs (14504, 3808) do NOT resolve to any `/media/{prefix}{ID}.{ext}` pattern — they likely use a different resolution mechanism (Angular app internal mapping or a separate API endpoint) - The Angular app resolves exhibits at runtime when clicked, rendering the image in a `.exhibits-dialog-container` overlay 3. **Current DOM state:** - Chrome CDP on port 9222, UWorld logged in - Currently showing a gonorrhea question (qId unknown) with exhibit showing Gram stain (U5570.png) - The exhibit link is `exhibit` — Angular rewrites the numeric href at render time 4. **Confirmed working URL patterns:** - `https://apps.uworld.com/media/L{ID}.jpg` or `.png` - `https://apps.uworld.com/media/U{ID}.jpg` or `.png` - `https://www.uworld.com/media/highresdefault/L{ID}.jpg` or `.png` - Not all exhibit IDs resolve this way — some may need the Angular app to resolve them 5. **Current deck stats:** - 1,822+ cards in "UWorld Weak Subtopics" - 275 cards have broken inline `` tags - Unknown number have exhibit links (not counted yet across all 186 tests) - The inline image fix prototype works: download via CDP, store in Anki media, rewrite `` src ### UNSOLVED: How to resolve ALL exhibit IDs to image URLs - Direct URL pattern works for SOME (21266, 79162) but not others (14504, 3808) - The Angular app's runtime resolution is the authoritative source - Possible approaches: a. Navigate to each exhibit question in Chrome, click exhibit, scrape the `` src from the rendered DOM b. Find the Angular API call that resolves exhibit IDs (likely a separate endpoint we haven't discovered) c. Build a mapping table by crawling questions and clicking exhibits ### Tomorrow's plan (Danny's request): - Danny will give 4 score reports - Analyze top 5 weakest areas from all 4 - Extract same questions + new ones - Total should be MORE than current 1,804 - Must include exhibit images this time
next_steps: Resolve the exhibit ID → media URL mapping. Try: (1) navigating to a question with exhibit ID 14504, clicking the exhibit, and checking what network request or image src appears, (2) look for a dedicated API endpoint like GetExhibit or GetQuestionMedia, (3) once mapping is understood, build a script that scans all exhibit questions, resolves their images, downloads them, and adds them to Anki cards.
